public_api_decisions.direction: Current @api declaration and public extension index explicitly retain the existing persister API and type dispatch adapter; two-type HTTP writes remain regression coverage.

Public supports(sourceType) dispatch is verified by TypedRelationshipTest: two types, autoconfiguration and explicit tags, all reader/updater endpoint methods, pagination, state isolation and configured reader fallback. Endpoint adapters do not provide representation preloading or durable transactions automatically.
RelationshipReadMap and CustomRouteMetadata are explicitly public @api DTOs; public signature regression tests retain the consumer contract.
